def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import glob
    import pandas as pd

    paths = [
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2023.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2015.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2014.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2016.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2012.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2006.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2007.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2009.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2018.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2011.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2005.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2008.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2020.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2004.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2022.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2021.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2002.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2017.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2013.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2010.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2003.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2019.csv",
    ]

    matched = []
    for p in paths:
        ms = glob.glob(p)
        if not ms:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"No files matched: {p}")
        matched.extend(ms)

    dfs = []
    for fp in sorted(set(matched)):
        df = pd.read_csv(fp, dtype=str)
        df["sourceFile"] = fp.split("/")[-1]
        dfs.append(df)

    out = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True, sort=False)
    return out

def process(loadWaterTesting) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    df = loadWaterTesting.copy()

    # Explicit columns based on observed schema
    yearCol = "Year"
    waterTypeCol = "Beach Type Description"  # values: Fresh / Marine
    exceedCol = "Violation"  # values like yes/no with case variants

    # Extract year
    df["_year"] = pd.to_numeric(df[yearCol], errors="coerce")

    # Freshwater beaches: Beach Type Description == 'Fresh'
    wt = df[waterTypeCol].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    freshBeaches = df[wt.eq("fresh")].copy()

    # Exceedance flag
    raw = freshBeaches[exceedCol].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

    trueVals = {"yes", "y", "true", "1"}
    falseVals = {"no", "n", "false", "0", "nan", ""}

    def to01(s: str):
        if s in trueVals:
            return 1
        if s in falseVals:
            return 0
        # fallback patterns
        if "yes" in s or "exceed" in s or "viol" in s or "fail" in s:
            return 1
        if "no" in s or "pass" in s or "meet" in s:
            return 0
        return np.nan

    freshBeaches["_exceed"] = raw.map(to01)

    # Keep only 2002-2023 inclusive
    freshBeaches = freshBeaches[(freshBeaches["_year"] >= 2002) & (freshBeaches["_year"] <= 2023)].copy()

    # Per-year exceedance rate (mean over non-null exceed flags)
    grp = (
        freshBeaches.groupby("_year", dropna=True)["_exceed"].agg(
            nSamples="count",
            nExceed="sum",
            rate="mean",
        )
        .reset_index()
        .rename(columns={"_year": "year"})
        .sort_values("year")
    )

    # Overall average freshwater beach exceedance rate across all samples
    overall = freshBeaches["_exceed"].mean()

    grp["overallAvgRate"] = overall

    # Compare using 2-decimal rounded rates per prompt
    grp["rate2"] = grp["rate"].round(2)
    grp["overall2"] = round(float(overall), 2) if pd.notna(overall) else np.nan
    grp["aboveAvg"] = grp["rate2"] > grp["overall2"]

    return grp

operators.customDisplayName: Compute freshwater beach bacterial exceedance rates by year using explicit schema: use Year as year, Beach Type Description=='Fresh' as freshwater beach filter, and Violation (case-insensitive yes/no) as exceedance indicator mapped to 0/1; filter years 2002-2023; groupby year to compute nSamples=count, nExceed=sum, rate=mean; compute overall freshwater-beach average exceedance rate across all samples; round per-year rate and overall average to 2 decimals and flag years where rate2 > overall2.
Select years where aboveAvg==True (per-year exceedance rate rounded to 2 decimals exceeds overall rounded average); return sorted unique integer years.
